segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Good morning, Jordan. Today we're doing the MRI of your brain with contrast that Dr. Kim ordered for your headaches.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Good morning. Honestly, I'm a little nervous about being in the machine.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: That's very common. Before the scan, the nurse will give you 1 milligram of lorazepam through your IV to help you relax.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: I'm placing your IV now. We'll use it for the lorazepam first and then for the gadolinium contrast during the second part of the scan.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Okay, the lorazepam is in. You may feel a little drowsy in a few minutes.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: We'll take the first set of images, then I'll inject the contrast and take the second set.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Contrast is going in now. Hold still for about ten more minutes.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: All done, Jordan. You did great. Since you had lorazepam, please have someone drive you home today.

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Thank you. My sister is here to pick me up.
